product_summary: Parker Hannifin is a global motion-and-control group; its Indian entity is the group's manufacturing/sales arm in India covering hydraulic cylinders and power units, hydraulic and pneumatic valves, rotary pumps, accumulators, filtration products (oil, fuel, air filters and filter elements), sealing solutions (O-rings, gaskets, mechanical seals), hose and tube fittings, quick couplings, instrumentation (pressure gauges, connectors), fluid connectors, and motion/automation components (bearings, gearboxes, drives, electromechanical actuators). Aerospace and automotive are served as end-markets, not as the core product line. NOTE ON EVIDENCE: parker.com returned HTTP 403 to every automated request (home, /in/en/, /in/en/products.html, about-us) and search engines returned only generic global pages, so the individual product pages could not be opened in this session. The product list above is therefore the group's publicly known portfolio, NOT a page-by-page verification of the Indian entity's catalogue: status = заявлено, не подтверждено (no customs line and no readable catalogue page was obtained).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - Indian subsidiary of a foreign manufacturer (Parker Hannifin Corp., USA); combines own manufacturing in India with import/distribution of group-made components. Role classification is not a rejection ground.
comment: HS 870894 = steering wheels, steering columns and steering boxes for motor vehicles (Chapter 87). This is a narrow automotive steering-parts heading and does not describe Parker's actual line, which is fluid power / motion control: pumps 8413, hydraulic motors and cylinders 8412, valves 8481, filters 8421, bearings 8482, gearing 8483, seals 4016/8484, fittings 7307/7412, hoses 3917, instrumentation 9026. Verdict per Rule 3: the company is KEPT, the code is corrected - match_status = wrong, actual codes as listed above; the declared 870894 is to be replaced by the factual code of whatever is actually shipped on each line (most likely 8412/8413/8481/8421). Industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aerospace & transport) is a partial misclassification: aerospace and automotive are end-use segments of a diversified industrial fluid-power supplier, not the company's product identity - the correct industry is industrial machinery / fluid power and motion control. Trader signs: the entity is a subsidiary of a foreign parent and its Indian operations mix local manufacture with distribution of imported group products, so a share of shipments may be trading rather than own production - this must be checked line by line against the customs declaration, not assumed. Product lines missing from the declaration: filtration (8421), sealing (4016/8484), fluid connectors and fittings (7307/7412/3917), instrumentation (9026), pneumatics (8481), bearings and gearing (8482/8483), and any genuine aerospace parts (8803) - none of these appear under 870894. No customs line was available in this session, so no shipment-level corroboration exists for any code; all codes above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' pending a customs record. No registry, revenue or volume data was researched per role scope; PAN, CIN and state are null (not public in the sources reachable here).
